theme_and_archetype.description: Editorial travel magazine meets modern booking UX. Asymmetrical, luxurious, utilizing generous whitespace and warm earthy tones inspired by Indian landscapes. Avoid generic corporate UI; instead prioritize tactile textures, confident typography, and immersive imagery.

scales.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl+ tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium font-serif
scales.h2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-medium font-serif

rules.generous_spacing: Use 2-3x typical padding (e.g., p-8 or p-12 instead of p-4)
rules.asymmetry_preferred: Use offset grids and negative space for visual tension

icons.style: Duotone or Thin weights to match the elegant editorial vibe. Avoid chunky solid icons.

specific_page_instructions.hero_landing: Create a split-screen or asymmetrical hero. Left side: The booking widget (flights, trains, buses, hotels) structured elegantly with white background, sharp corners, and thin borders. Right side: A massive, stunning destination image that bleeds off the edge. Do not use a generic center-aligned text-over-image hero.
specific_page_instructions.booking_widget: Use a tabbed interface. Active tab has a 2px Indigo underline. Input fields should be borderless or have a single bottom border. Use Shadcn components for Select, DatePicker, and Popover, but strip away the default Vercel look. Make them feel bespoke, using our Cormorant serif for the dates or values.
specific_page_instructions.destination_explorer: Use the 'Tetris' bento grid. Mix large images spanning multiple columns with smaller text-focused cards. Implement hover zoom on images. Use the terracotta and ochre accents to highlight 'Best Time to Visit' or 'Popular Spots'. Integrate live weather subtly with elegant iconography.
specific_page_instructions.booking_results: For flight/train/bus/hotel lists, avoid standard boxy cards. Use a clean, horizontal list view separated by delicate 1px borders (#E2D8CE). Emphasize the departure/arrival times using the serif font in large sizes. Include prominent filters on the left sidebar.
specific_page_instructions.checkout_confirmation: Maintain the editorial feel. The order summary should look like an elegant printed receipt or ticket, using monospace or neat sans-serif alignments. Include the 'travel_itinerary_flatlay' image as a subtle background or side image.

testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements (tabs, search inputs, booking buttons, filter checkboxes) MUST have a data-testid attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., flight-search-button, destination-tab, passenger-count-input).
